title: Semantic Layer Adoption
dataSources: dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow query logs, Cube API request logs and pre-aggregation build metrics (`cube:api`), AtScale engine query logs, LookML validation and metric-definition change events.
app: dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow and Cube query logs and APIs via HEC scripted inputs; AtScale engine logs; LookML content-validator output.
spl:
index=bi (sourcetype=dbt:semantic_layer OR sourcetype=cube:api) event=query
| stats count as queries, dc(consumer) as consumers, dc(metric_name) as metrics_used by consuming_tool
| sort - queries
description: Reports how much each downstream tool queries the semantic layer and how many distinct metrics are used, measuring adoption of the governed metrics standard.
value: A semantic layer only pays off when tools actually use it; adoption metrics show whether the governed-metrics investment is landing.
implementation: Ingest query logs; schedule weekly; chart adoption by tool; identify teams bypassing the layer.
visualization: Bar chart of queries by tool, adoption trend.
grandmaExplanation: We show how much your teams use the shared, agreed definitions of key numbers instead of making their own.
